name: Arsema Doji Wordofa
headline: Product Manager & QA professional — delivery-focused, technical, AI-fluent
summary: Delivery-focused Product Manager and QA professional with 3+ years owning the full cycle from brief to release across ERP, CRM, eCommerce, and healthcare EHR platforms. Resolves ambiguity before it reaches engineers, runs QA end to end, gathers requirements directly from clients, and owns release schedules independently. Started as a software engineer, which shows up as technical fluency (API testing, SQL, reading React/Laravel/PHP/MySQL) most PMs don't have.

Owns requirements, Jira ticket structure, and alignment between engineering, client, and roadmap
Took an EHR from concept + mocks to a 7-phase, dependency-sequenced delivery roadmap
Used competitive research (4-5 incumbents) not as a feature checklist but to sequence what to build first
